verdict.rationale: Tags can be applied through the API and managed with the CLI. Subscribers can be bulk created or updated via `/batch/subscribers`. Membership can be read back through `GET /fetch/search`, which filters subscribers by tags or by a segment with paging. That covers the tag-based version of the story end to end. Missing for 10: evidence of creating or editing segment definitions via API (segments are described only as saved filters), detail on paging or completeness guarantees for membership reads, and independent hands-on corroboration.
